channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] New York sues prediction market platform Kalshi alleging 'illegal gambling operation'
item.description: New York officials sued prediction market platform Kalshi, calling it an "illegal, unlicensed gambling operation" as the state seeks to halt its operations and force the company to forfeit profits.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Senior FIFA official resigns over Infantino's World Cup sell-off plan
item.description: Two senior FIFA officials criticized Gianni Infantino's World Cup sell-off plan Friday with one resigning as a presidential adviser and a second saying staff were deceived by project that must not go ahead.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Publix expands frozen berry recall due to possible E.Coli contamination: FDA
item.description: Publix announced it recalled all lots of GreenWise Organic Frozen Whole Blueberries and Whole Mixed Berries due to possible E. Coli contamination, according to the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Dozens dead as massive migration wave hits Spain’s Ceuta border
item.description: Tens of thousands of migrants crossed from Morocco into Spain’s Ceuta enclave in 24 hours, overwhelming authorities as at least 41 people died.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Parent pushes for more special needs resources in both public and private schools
item.description: As we get closer to the beginning of the school year, school closings and consolidations have some parents concerned about education quality for special needs students.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Hillsborough County tax collector hosts annual school supply drive for public school teachers
item.description: The Hillsborough County Tax Collector's Office is collecting school supplies for public school teachers throughout the month of July at all nine of its locations across the county.

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Lakeland police to hold press conference on arrests made in two homicide cases
item.description: Lakeland Police Chief Sam Taylor will hold a press conference at 10:30 a.m. from the Lakeland Police Department regarding arrests made in two homicide cases.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: hurricane] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa General strengthens hurricane defenses with AquaFence upgrades
item.description: With hurricane season underway, Tampa General Hospital is reinforcing its defenses against flooding and storm surge on its Davis Islands campus.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] St. Petersburg's 30-year Duke Energy agreement expires Friday: What it means for customers
item.description: One of St. Petersburg's longest-running agreements is set to expire Friday, but residents shouldn't expect to lose power when the calendar turns to August.
